```{r}
#| label: audit-setup
#| include: false
root<-Sys.getenv("BMI_REPO_ROOT");run<-Sys.getenv("BMI_RUN_DIR");review<-Sys.getenv("BMI_REVIEW_DIR")
if(!nzchar(root)||!dir.exists(run)||!dir.exists(review))stop("Use saved-run rendering")
source(file.path(root,"R","analysis.R"))
Sys.setenv(BMI_REPORT_ID="audit")
load_common_input<-load_triangulation_input<-bmi_load_input<-fit_bmi_model<-fit_registered_models<-bmi_run_analysis<-function(...)stop("Render tripwire: clinical input/model fitting forbidden")
source(file.path(root,"reports","table_passthrough.R"))
bmi_report_table<-bmi_raw_table_writer(bmi_report_table)
bundle<-bmi_read_bundle(run);a<-bundle$analysis
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev=if(knitr::is_latex_output())"cairo_pdf"else"png",fig.width=7,fig.height=8)
captions<-utils::read.csv(file.path(review,"figures","captions.csv"),stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
page<-bmi_page
figure<-function(id) {
  if(knitr::is_latex_output())return(bmi_figure(id,review,captions))
  # Keep the complete audit portable with its adjacent vector-figure directory.
  markup<-capture.output(bmi_figure(id,review,captions))
  markup<-gsub("<img ","<img loading=\"lazy\" ",markup,fixed=TRUE)
  cat(gsub(paste0(review,"/"),"",markup,fixed=TRUE),sep="\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: audit-status
#| results: asis
cat(if(bundle$manifest$mode=="fixture")"**ARTIFICIAL DATA ONLY. No source qualification or clinical result follows from this report.**\n\n"else"**Protected internal research audit. Exact aggregates and rare categories are not automatically safe for public sharing.**\n\n")
bmi_report_table(a$source_audit,"Source status and interpretation limits",keys="requirement")
cat("Run: ",bundle$manifest$run_id,". Numerical review: ",bundle$manifest$numerically_reviewed,". Scientific review: ",bundle$manifest$scientifically_reviewed,".\n\n",sep="")
```

## Coverage and provenance

Every required population, variable and model is indexed below. Identical stage summaries are shared only after exact equality of all nonidentifier fields, with an explicit stage-to-display mapping; this does not assert identical patient membership. Missing, pending, failed, empty and not-applicable states are explicit. No patient identifiers, exact dates, individual predictions or model frames are exported. CSV/RDS tables retain full numerical precision. Distribution/prediction coordinates are exported in full; their complete plotted ranges are displayed here rather than printing every coordinate as a separate table row.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-index
#| results: asis
if(nrow(a$model_registry))for(id in a$model_registry$model_id)cat("- [",id,"](#model-",substr(digest::digest(id,algo="sha256"),1,12),")\n",sep="")
bmi_report_table(a$coverage_index,"Coverage index",keys="kind")
bmi_report_table(a$variable_dictionary,"Complete variable dictionary",keys="variable_id")
```

## Detailed observational cohort construction

Source records, encounter versions and patients have distinct counting units. Global pre-index accounting belongs to the combined reference. Subgroup input/eligibility recheck nodes begin with already fixed indexes; they are not new upstream extraction counts or a new clinical selection. First-failure exclusions are exclusive at their declared grain; all-reason counts overlap. Gas and ICD samples are parallel overlapping analytic branches.

```{r}
#| label: detailed-flow
#| results: asis
ids<-tools::file_path_sans_ext(list.files(file.path(review,"figures"),pattern="^F0-detail-.*\\.png$",recursive=TRUE))
for(id in ids){figure(id);page()}
for(t in c("rfs_summary","rfs_outcomes","rfs_combinations","rfs_by_bmi","bmi_provenance","demographic_crosswalk","prior_run_reconciliation","rfs_semantics","expected_models","cohort_nodes","cohort_edges","exclusion_reasons","exclusion_overlaps","population_registry","timing_audit","observation_patterns","evidence_by_bmi","numerical_reconciliation")) {
 cat("\n### ",gsub("_"," ",t),"\n\n",sep="");bmi_report_table(a[[t]],t,keys=intersect(c("population_id","outcome_id"),names(a[[t]])))
}
```

## Complete stage and variable profiles

Identifiers receive cardinality and linkage summaries. Date values are protected. Continuous variables receive exact type-7 quantiles, missingness, full-range distributions and ECDFs. Selected Gaussian KDEs share the source-variable bandwidth and scale by observed population mass. Constant/sparse variables are displayed without a fabricated KDE. Category percentages identify all-patient and nonmissing denominators; named unknown categories retain their approved meaning.

```{r}
#| label: full-stage-atlas-tables
#| results: asis
for(t in c("variable_summary","category_counts","missingness_patterns","comissingness")) {
 cat("\n### ",gsub("_"," ",t),"\n\n",sep="");if("variable_id" %in% names(a[[t]]))bmi_profile_report(a[[t]],t)else bmi_grouped_report(a[[t]],t,groups="population_id")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: full-stage-atlas-figures
#| results: asis
bmi_report_table(utils::read.csv(file.path(review,"figures","atlas-index.csv")),"Atlas index: every plotted stage maps to an identical-profile representative",keys="variable_id")
for(p in list.files(file.path(review,"figures"),pattern="^F3-.*\\.png$",recursive=TRUE)) {figure(tools::file_path_sans_ext(p));page()}
```

## Every planned regression

Each population basis is fixed at its adjustment-complete BMI percentiles 5, 35, 65 and 95; age remains linear. No automatic estimator substitution, category pooling or model selection occurs. Model-based intervals condition on the empirical reference. Apparent fit is assessed on training data. Influence flags do not remove patients.

```{r}
#| label: full-regression-audit
#| results: asis
bmi_report_table(a$bmi_basis,"Fixed spline basis",keys="basis_id")
if(nrow(a$model_registry))for(id in a$model_registry$model_id) {
 page();cat("\n### Model: ",id," {#model-",substr(digest::digest(id,algo="sha256"),1,12),"}\n\n",sep="")
 for(t in c("model_registry","factor_references","coefficients","coefficient_covariance","model_fit_diagnostics","model_residual_bins","model_influence_summary","model_support")) {
  z<-a[[t]];if("model_id" %in% names(z))z<-z[z$model_id==id,,drop=FALSE]
  if(t=="model_residual_bins")z<-z[!grepl("^(hist_|ecdf_)",z$diagnostic),,drop=FALSE]
  if(t=="coefficient_covariance"&&nrow(z)){
    bmi_covariance_report(z,"Complete coefficient covariance","term1","term2","covariance")
    bmi_covariance_report(z,"Complete coefficient correlation","term1","term2","correlation")
  }else bmi_report_table(z,t,keys=intersect(c("term","metric","variable_id"),names(z))[1:min(1,length(intersect(c("term","metric","variable_id"),names(z))))])
 }
 group<-a$model_registry$analysis_population_id[a$model_registry$model_id==id];view<-bmi_group_view(a,group);fid<-paste0(group,"/F4-",match(sub(paste0("^",group,"::"),"",id),view$model_registry$model_id));figure(fid)
}
bmi_report_table(a$linear_spline_comparison,"Same-sample linear-versus-spline comparisons",keys="outcome_id")
```

## Relationship, support and scenario reconciliation

Curves are policy-independent. Gas curves and scenarios standardize to their outcome-observed training populations; ICD curves use C_icd with known diagnosis capture. Observation models describe evidence availability over C. No physiological outcomes are projected to untested patients. Full-cohort MAR/MNAR projections remain only in the frozen historical run. No cross-model difference test is inferred from independent interval overlap.

```{r}
#| label: audit-relationships
#| results: asis
for(group in c("primary","obesity_only"))for(id in c("F1-A","F1-B","F1-C","F1-detail","F2")){figure(paste0(group,"/",id));page()}
for(t in c("fixed_bmi_contrasts","prediction_support","policy_registry","policy_totals","policy_contributions","policy_contribution_covariance")) {
 cat("\n### ",gsub("_"," ",t),"\n\n",sep="")
 if(t=="policy_contribution_covariance"&&nrow(a[[t]])){
  z<-a[[t]];groups<-c("model_id","reference_id","policy_id","method");key<-do.call(paste,c(z[groups],sep=" | "))
  for(ix in split(seq_len(nrow(z)),factor(key,levels=unique(key)))){cat("\n**",key[ix[1]],"**\n\n",sep="");bmi_covariance_report(z[ix,],"Complete original-band contribution covariance","bin1","bin2","covariance")}
 }else if(t %in% c("policy_contributions","implied_missing_probabilities"))bmi_grouped_report(a[[t]],t,groups=c("model_id","reference_id","policy_id","method"))
 else bmi_report_table(a[[t]],t,keys=intersect(c("model_id","reference_id"),names(a[[t]])))
}
for(p in list.files(file.path(review,"figures"),pattern="^F5-.*\\.png$",recursive=TRUE)){figure(tools::file_path_sans_ext(p));page()}
```

## Export and review record

The immutable bundle contains all tables, configuration, source hashes and input receipt. Figures and reports are fresh views of that bundle. Rendering is guarded against clinical input reads and model refits. Consult the adjacent render receipt, figure manifest and actual visual-review receipt for checks performed; successful rendering does not establish source or scientific acceptance.
